brief_title: IGOB131 As A GLP-1 Modulator For Metabolic Disorders In Adults With Obesity
official_title: Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-controlled Trial Of IGOB131 As A GLP-1 Modulator For Metabolic Disorders In Adults With Obesity

primary_outcomes.measure: Effect of IGOB131 on postprandial GLP-1 response (0-180 minutes)
Effect of IGOB131 on fasting plasma GLP-1 concentrations
Effect of IGOB131 on DPP-4 enzymatic activity

brief_summary:
This clinical trial will investigate the effect of standardized Irvingia gabonensis extract (IGOB131) on GLP-1 dynamics, DPP-4 activity, metabolic parameters, and inflammatory markers in adults with obesity.

The study will compare IGOB131 to a placebo to find out if it exerts any significant metabolic benefits through GLP-1 and DPP-4 modulation, and the reduction of adiposity and systemic inflammation.

Participants will:

Take IGOB131 or a placebo every day for 16 weeks Visit the clinic once every 4 weeks for checkups and tests

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males and females with BMI between 25 and 34 kg/m²
* Participants aged 18 to 65 years old
* Participants willing to comply with the study protocol

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants younger than 18 years or older than 65 years
* Participants not available for the study period
* Morbid obesity (BMI \> 34.9 kg/m²)
* Diabetes mellitus requiring daily insulin management
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding
* Active infection
* Systemic diseases, including HIV/AIDS, Active hepatitis, Clinical signs of active malignancy within the past 5 years
* Use of any medication or natural health product that might affect the parameters of interest in this study
